sources.snippet: π₀.₅ (lerobot/pi05_base) full fine-tune on mliu48/telearms-yam-cube-v5-exp-random-100 (revision 8960f720): 1,000 simulated bimanual YAM demonstrations of 10 tasks, 962,999 frames at 30 Hz, three 224×224 cameras, no domain randomization.

sources.snippet: Training is still running. π₀.₅ (lerobot/pi05_base) full fine-tune on mliu48/telearms-yam-cube-v5-ablation-mixed (revision 20dca673): 60,093 simulated bimanual YAM demonstrations, a mixture of demonstrations of 7 tasks, 77.4M frames at 30 Hz, three cameras rendered like the real RealSense cameras (16:9) and letterboxed to 224×224.
